# aegntic.ai

> Mattae Cooper (@aegntic) — independent AI-agent engineer. Primary product: aedex (catalog-first data marketplace CLI for agents).

## Primary product
- aedex — https://aedex.ing — discover, inspect, and run agent data tools. One CLI, one balance.

## Services
- Custom AI-agent builds (Rust, Go, TypeScript, Python)
- Automation infrastructure
- Developer / agent tooling (MCP, CLI, Claude Code ecosystem)
- AE Audits — selective decision review (not primary offer)

## Work
- aedex — Catalog-first data marketplace for agents. Discover, inspect, and run hundreds of data tools — one CLI, one balance. (https://aedex.ing)
- Cognitive OS — Cognitive Operating System — multi-harness agent policy, verification chains, and execution stack. (/cognitive-os/)
- Cognitive Operator — A single operator that persists, coordinates, and acts over time — not a chatbot session. Built on Cognitive OS primitives. (/cognitive-operator/)
- CLDCDE — Claude Code ecosystem hub — tools, patterns, and operator infrastructure for agentic development. (https://cldcde.cc)
- Prologue — Universal MCP discovery and memory library — cut setup from hours to minutes. (https://logue.pro)
- clawREFORM — Agent-city surface for coordination, reform patterns, and multi-agent operations. (https://clawreform.com)
- AE Audits — Structured adversarial council for expensive decisions — available on request, not the primary offer. (/audits/)
- prompt.fail — Public surface for prompt failure modes and agent edge cases. (https://prompt.fail)
